_comment: Model ids verified 2026-11-26 against the official model pages (see ARGE brief B3.2). Prices are USD per 1M tokens, null = price not entered yet. price_cache_read and price_cache_write price prompt tokens served from or written to the provider's prompt cache (Anthropic needs the cache marker the adapter sends, DeepSeek caches on its own, Gemini 4 showed no cache hits live), a missing value means price_in. DeepSeek prices are the off-peak rates. API keys are never stored here, only the environment variable names. deepseek.thinking maps a role (pass1, pass2, roundtrip, literal, J1, J2, J3) or 'default' to true / false, a missing entry keeps the API default (thinking on). literal and roundtrip are mechanical tasks and run without thinking, live runs showed thinking alone can use up the output limit there. max_output_tokens is the model's own output maximum, measured live on 2026-11-27 (Claude 5.5 128000 and DeepSeek 393216 as the API states it, Gemini 4 accepts any value and caps it at its own maximum). Every call asks for it, only generated tokens are billed, so a reply is never cut while a model thinks.
